description.value: Paradox Hotel Vancouver is an independent luxury boutique hotel occupying Arthur Erickson's iconic twisting tower on the Golden Mile of downtown Vancouver, holding Forbes Travel Guide Four Star (2025–2026) and AAA Four Diamond ratings. The 147-room property includes the award-winning Xylia Natural Spa, Mott 32 Vancouver restaurant, and Mansion Nightclub. Its central location places guests within easy reach of Stanley Park, Granville Island, and Vancouver's urban cycling network.
